allocation_status: Teaching design; no official allocation printed in the verified table.
rationale: Fourteen40minute lessons separately address six source-named bond/interaction descriptions,structure/property evidence,diamond/graphite/Al uses,material selection,two distinct project activities and an independent final. Actual optional tests/model/outreach may require approved additional time and provision;record any unmet source actions rather than claiming completion.
prerequisites: Valence counts,ionic charges and molecule/element/compound distinctions.
Recognise a scientific model and distinguish reference data from measurements.
teacher_confirmation_required: Approve safe modelling materials,accessibility,pacing and any project finishing time.

No high-temperature melting tests,iodine handling,unknown powders,flames,mains or molten chemicals. Any actual property investigation needs an approved local protocol/equipment;only optional known salt/room-temperature-water observation is proposed here.
Record each actual property observation separately from supplied melting/boiling/conductivity references.
Provide/preview a virtual bond lab if available;paper diagrams do not certify digital navigation.
Observe actual molecular and ionic-fragment products;plan-only is not construction.
Approve actual community presentation and product-specific manufacturer information;draft does not certify delivery or behaviour change.
Keep elemental examples distinct from compounds and hydrogen/van der Waals attractions distinct from internal covalent bonds.

lesson_map.title: What does a bond description explain?
How does electron transfer relate to an ionic lattice?
How do shared pairs make molecular bonds?
Can one atom donate a whole bonding pair?
How does a metal conduct while solid?
Which structures explain the supplied properties?
What would count as a property investigation?
How can the same element have different uses?
What does a bond model tell us about cookware?
Which material fits the stated job?
Can models distinguish molecules from ionic structures?
How can a community message remain accurate?
Can bonding evidence support an independent material choice?
